name: cheminformatics
description: A collection of cheminformatics tasks for graph- and molecule-focused machine learning, measuring models on molecular property prediction, graph classification/regression, and related molecule-generation tasks. The benchmark evaluates model capability to learn chemical structure–property relationships from graph-based representations and supports both classification and regression evaluations.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (ROC-AUC for classification tasks; RMSE/MAE for regression; validity/novelty/diversity metrics for generation)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (ROC-AUC for classification, RMSE/MAE for regression)
reputation: A community dataset collection on Hugging Face used by graph-ML and cheminformatics researchers; moderate niche adoption.
